scope: 16 authored counterarguments/expected requirement paths; no executed simulation, live incident, original casualty or independent participant review

cases.trigger: A report is forwarded repeatedly but no crew accepts
cases.control_path: RC06/07/17: responsible receiving officer pursues competent available help and preserves protected first receipt
cases.delivery_and_source_requirement: Actual qualified arrival, safe transport/receiving and earlier useful time required; ticket count is no delivery
cases.continuing_rights_and_obligations: Unmet rescue/clinical/support duties and direct AP/V/OJ routes survive
cases.status: written reasoning only; actual path unverified

cases.trigger: Poor locality cannot fund continuous readiness
cases.control_path: RC01/16/17 and C04 national limited essential-guarantee/source duty; council opposition can contest source
cases.delivery_and_source_requirement: No invented funds, coerced neighbor or automatic takeover; actual paid accepted alternate needed
cases.continuing_rights_and_obligations: Guarantee, funding challenge and lawful local political control persist
cases.status: written reasoning only; actual path unverified

cases.trigger: One driver and clinician appear in two simultaneous mutual-aid rosters

cases.delivery_and_source_requirement: Do not count the same qualified time twice; missing qualified cover remains missing
cases.continuing_rights_and_obligations: HG/NC/ED and donor due duties and TW/WL rest/exit remain
cases.status: written reasoning only; actual path unverified

cases.trigger: Director refuses aid to an opposition neighborhood

cases.delivery_and_source_requirement: Actual unimplicated competent receiving/executor needed, not Director credibility permission
cases.continuing_rights_and_obligations: Urgent protection continues; refusal needs evidence, no allegation as automatic guilt
